title: Global minimizers for a two-sided biharmonic Alt-Caffarelli problem
summary: We study global minimizers of biharmonic analogues of the Alt-Caffarelli functional. It turns out that half-space solutions are global minimizers for the two-sided Alt-Caffarelli functional, but not in the one-sided case. In addition, we identify a further class of global minimizers, all of which have constant Laplacian. Recent work by J. Lamboley and M. Nahon reduces potential global minimizers in dimension two to four possible categories. Our work shows that three of these categories persist in any dimension and are in fact global minimizers.
